group.title: An inspection-camera connection
group.passage:
Man: The inspection camera loses its connection whenever we switch from preview mode to recording.
Woman: Does that happen with every workstation?
Man: Only with the two computers running the older driver. The newest workstation records normally.
Woman: Then please install driver version four point two before changing the firmware. I've put the download link in the support ticket.
Man: Will that erase the saved camera profiles?
Woman: No. The driver update keeps those profiles, but close the capture application first. Call me if the connection still drops afterward.
group.passageZh:
男：每當我們從預覽模式切換到錄影，檢測相機就會斷線。
女：每一台工作站都會發生嗎？
男：只有使用舊版驅動程式的兩台電腦會。最新那台工作站錄影正常。
女：那麼在更動韌體之前，請先安裝四點二版驅動程式。我已把下載連結放進客服工單。
男：這會清除儲存的相機設定檔嗎？
女：不會。更新驅動程式會保留那些設定檔，但請先關閉擷取程式。如果之後仍會斷線，再打電話給我。
